subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Grandparent Scam
description: A quick, practical guide to The Grandparent Scam.

hook.text: A frantic voice calls: 'Grandma, I'm in jail. Please send bail money. Don't tell Mom.'

buildup.text: The caller claims to be a grandchild in trouble — arrested, hospitalized, or stranded abroad.

discovery.text: AI voice cloning can now replicate a real grandchild's voice from a social media video.

twist.text: The emotional urgency makes grandparents wire thousands before thinking to verify the story.

climax.text: Grandparent scams steal over $1 billion per year in the U.S. Victims average over $9,000 lost.

punchline.text: Love makes you act first and think later. Scammers know that.

quiz.question: What new technology makes grandparent scams more convincing?
options: AI voice cloning from social media
